===== BEGIN H2_design.txt =====
H2 frozen 2026-11-18 23:49:00 UTC. Incremental FINAL Job24 count15 patch SHA256 e98c2a23afd20828d25de3da92eca89c9db2d877667b4bc296d769407354aade.
One use per active-search-Board king destination excluded by pawn/king taboo in generate_legal_evasions. Original r15d would run full square_attacked_with_occupancy: remove king origin from occupancy, add destination, remove captured destination from enemy attacking piece availability. Diagnostic invokes that pure original helper and compares resulting legal Boolean with optimized rejection=false. No Board::make_move, recursive generation, cache/history mutation or old counter hook.
Attribution requires shortcut_count::tt_board==this. H29 diagnostic private-Board regeneration and calls with missing context are not production uses; excluded candidates there counted separately as foreign_board or missing_context skips. No skipped candidate is a passing use. This restricts scope to active search Board calls, not all API callers/perft.
Classes White/Black, pawn-only/king-only/both taboo, capture/quiet separately partition uses. WRONG16 flips private original-legal Boolean only White; actual mask/filter/output unchanged. Shared attack helper/tables and accepted legal-board domain mean this is old-vs-skipped-safety equivalence, not independent absolute legality proof or handling of illegal king-adjacent inputs. Capture occupancy and removed masks follow exact original call rather than static attacked-square assumption.

===== END H2_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H47_design.txt =====
H47 main-search lazy threat-map reset: old unconditional eager lesser-attacker snapshot reconstructed once after reset and before main MovePicker construction. Snapshot uses local bitboards and old unconditional pawn/minor/rook union recipe, no counted H71 helper. Node-lifetime holder records consumed/unread scopes, but does not activate any reader context by itself.
Separate H47ReadScope activates thread-local pointer only while a main picker.next(skip_quiets) call executes, restores prior pointer immediately on return. Main loop recurses only after scope is gone. Thus nested qsearch, singular searches, same Board/key/ply revisits and history updates outside picker calls cannot borrow outer main snapshot. Every hook additionally requires Board address, key and ply equality. MovePicker constructor was inspected: it does not consume lesser masks; no constructor coverage is implied.
One use per matching consumed full piece-type mask at QuietScorer, quiet_history or rework_entry reader. Compare with node eager snapshot. White-only WRONG16 XORbit0 affects private expected mask, never actual cached masks or scoring. White/Black, three reader classes and four piece groups partition uses. Separate consumed/unread node scopes and next_calls do not count as matching mask reads. Readers not reached retain zero-class evidence; scope is main-picker reads, not all main-search lifetime/cache writes.
H42 existing context and comparison code remain unchanged; added H47 hooks are adjacent and independently gated. All old27 counters, including H42, must remain exact per search. References share board representation/attack helpers and valid node-state inputs; no absolute attack legality or concurrent lifetime proof. Eager diagnostic extra calculations may change timing only, not search state; no new make/unmake or old counted hook. Fresh snapshot is not separately rebuilt at every reader.

===== END H47_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H47_cross_review.txt =====
H47 read-only review 2026-11-18 23:50 UTC.
Opened staged H47Context/ReadScope, mask consumers and main picker loop. Eager old unconditional map snapshot is node-local; active H47 TLS exists only inside h47_next wrapping actual picker.next. ReadScope destructor restores previous context before recursive child search. Every reader also matches Board address/key/ply. Snapshot after lazy ready reset remains same board semantics. One main loop callsite uses wrapper; no second picker generation or old reference hook.
White private expectedmask XOR only; actual map/history unchanged. H42 instrumentation left intact except adjacent additional H47 reader calls. Counters distinguish consumed-mask uses, next invocations and scopes consumed/unread; unread scopes not matches. Shared attack formulas/primitives mean old eager-vs-lazy consumer equivalence, not independent legality proof. No source edits or native experiment in this review.

===== END H47_cross_review.txt =====

+struct H47Context {
+    const Board* board;
+    std::uint64_t key;
+    int ply;
+    b4::LesserThreats reference;
+    bool enabled,read=false;
+    H47Context(const Board& b,int p,bool on):board(&b),key(b.key()),ply(p),enabled(on) {
+        if(!on)return;
+        const Color them=opposite(b.side_to_move());
+        const Bitboard occ=b.occupied();
+        const Bitboard pawn=pawn_attacks_bb(them,b.pieces(them,Pawn));
+        reference.by_type[Pawn]=reference.by_type[Knight]=reference.by_type[Bishop]=pawn;
+        Bitboard minor=pawn;
+        for(Bitboard bb=b.pieces(them,Knight);bb;)minor|=attacks::knight(pop_lsb(bb));
+        for(Bitboard bb=b.pieces(them,Bishop);bb;)minor|=attacks::bishop(pop_lsb(bb),occ);
+        reference.by_type[Rook]=minor;
+        for(Bitboard bb=b.pieces(them,Rook);bb;)minor|=attacks::rook(pop_lsb(bb),occ);
+        reference.by_type[Queen]=minor;
+    }
+    ~H47Context(){if(enabled)shortcut_count::scope_h47(read);}
+};
+void h47_consume(const Board& board,int ply,int pt,Bitboard actual,int reader) {
+    H47Context* c=h47_current;
+    if(!c || c->board!=&board || c->ply!=ply || c->key!=board.key())return;
+    c->read=true;
+    Bitboard expected=c->reference.by_type[static_cast<std::size_t>(pt)];
+#if FORGE_SHORTCUT_WRONG16
+    if(board.side_to_move()==White)expected^=Bitboard{1};
+#endif
+    const int piecegroup=pt==Rook?1:(pt==Queen?2:((pt==King||pt==NoPieceType)?3:0));
+    shortcut_count::record_h47(actual!=expected,board.side_to_move()==White,reader,piecegroup,board);
+}
+struct H47ReadScope {
+    H47Context* previous;

+        h47_current=c.enabled?&c:nullptr;
+        if(c.enabled)shortcut_count::next_h47();
+    }
+    ~H47ReadScope(){h47_current=previous;}
+};
